description: Discover brighter, clearer skin with NIVEA Luminous Even Glow Oil Control Face Crème & Moisturiser Serum, an advanced dark spot correction serum designed to reduce pigmentation, acne marks, blemishes and uneven skin tone. Powered by Patented Thiamidol, the formula targets pigmentation at its root cause and is clinically proven to be 60X more effective than Vitamin C in reducing dark spots. This oil control face serum contains 1.8% Salicylic Acid, which gently exfoliates dead skin cells, unclogs pores and helps reduce acne, excess oil and breakouts, making it an ideal serum for oily and acne-prone skin. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. Enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, this hydrating face serum deeply moisturizes the skin, improves skin texture and restores natural glow. Green Tea Extracts help balance natural oils and keep skin fresh and mattified for hours. Suitable for men and women with all skin types, this brightening face serum works as a daily skincare serum to improve skin clarity, hydration and oil balance, helping reveal visibly smoother, radiant and even-tone glowing skin.
